description: Daihan Lidocaine HCl Injection is a sterile, amide-type local anaesthetic manufactured in South Korea and supplied in multi-dose vials for professional use. It provides rapid-onset, epinephrine-free local anaesthesia for infiltration and nerve-block techniques. In aesthetic practice it is used to numb treatment sites and to supplement anaesthesia during injectable and minor procedural work.
howItWorks: Lidocaine hydrochloride blocks voltage-gated sodium channels in nerve membranes, preventing the initiation and conduction of pain impulses to produce reversible local anaesthesia. Onset is rapid, and the depth and duration of the block depend on the concentration, volume and injection site.
composition: Lidocaine hydrochloride 1% (10 mg/mL) or 2% (20 mg/mL), epinephrine-free; commonly supplied as 20 mL vials, 10 vials per box.
usageNotes: Prescription-only; for administration by, or under the direction of, a licensed practitioner. Sterile, single-patient handling; observe maximum safe dose limits and aspirate before injection to avoid intravascular delivery. Store per label and do not use if the solution is discoloured or the vial seal is compromised.
features: Amide-type local anaesthetic with rapid onset
benefits: Reliable site anaesthesia improves patient comfort and cooperation
Two concentrations allow dosing flexibility across procedures
Multi-dose vials suit high-throughput clinics
Widely familiar agent simplifies staff training
Cost-effective consumable for a busy injectables menu
indications: Local infiltration anaesthesia for injectable procedures
Numbing before minor dermatological and aesthetic procedures
Adjunct anaesthesia for cannula-based filler work
Pain control during ancillary in-clinic procedures

description: Huons Lidocaine HCl Injection is a sterile, amide-type local anaesthetic from Huons Co., Ltd. of South Korea, supplied in multi-dose vials. It delivers fast-acting, reliable local anaesthesia for infiltration, nerve-block, dental and aesthetic procedures. Huons has received US FDA ANDA approvals for its 1% and 2% lidocaine hydrochloride injection vials.
howItWorks: Lidocaine hydrochloride reversibly blocks voltage-gated sodium channels in nerve membranes, stopping pain-impulse conduction to produce local anaesthesia. Optional epinephrine-containing variants add vasoconstriction to slow absorption, prolong the block and reduce bleeding at the site.
composition: Lidocaine hydrochloride 1% (200 mg/20 mL) or 2% (400 mg/20 mL) multi-dose vials; plain and epinephrine-containing (1:100,000) variants are produced.
usageNotes: Prescription-only; for administration by, or under the direction of, a licensed practitioner. Sterile, single-patient handling; respect maximum dose limits and aspirate to avoid intravascular injection. Store per label and inspect for discolouration or seal damage before use.
features: Amide local anaesthetic in 1% and 2% strengths
US FDA ANDA-approved lidocaine injection line
benefits: Fast, dependable anaesthesia for injectable and minor procedures
Epinephrine option prolongs effect and limits bleeding
Multi-dose vials support high patient volumes
FDA-approved line supports quality assurance messaging
Familiar agent keeps training overhead low
indications: Numbing before aesthetic and minor surgical procedures
Adjunct anaesthesia for filler and device-based treatments

description: This is sterile, preservative-free 0.9% sodium chloride (normal saline) solution for injection, used as a diluent in aesthetic practice. It is the standard reconstitution fluid for lyophilised botulinum toxin and is also used to reconstitute hyaluronidase. Preservative-free normal saline is the diluent specified by botulinum toxin manufacturers for reconstitution.
howItWorks: Reconstitution dissolves the vacuum-dried toxin (or lyophilised enzyme) into a measured volume of fluid, producing a solution of predictable concentration for accurate dosing. The isotonic 0.9% saline matches physiological osmolarity, and gentle mixing avoids the agitation that can denature the toxin protein.
composition: Sodium chloride 0.9% (isotonic), sterile and preservative-free; commonly supplied in small-volume ampoules or vials (e.g. 2-10 mL).
usageNotes: Use only sterile, preservative-free 0.9% saline for toxin reconstitution; preserved saline is generally avoided per manufacturer labelling. Introduce the diluent gently to prevent foaming or violent agitation. Single-use; reconstituted toxin should be used within the manufacturer's stated window (commonly within 24 hours).
benefits: Enables accurate, reproducible toxin dilution
Preservative-free profile aligns with toxin labelling
Low-cost, essential consumable for injectable clinics
Supports flexible dilution ratios across protocols
Ubiquitous, easy-to-stock inventory item
indications: Reconstitution of hyaluronidase for filler dissolution
Dilution of injectable solutions to a target concentration
Irrigation and flushing in minor procedures
Diluent for mesotherapy cocktails where appropriate

description: The Nanum Mirror Cannula is a sterile, single-use blunt-tip micro-cannula for dermal filler and fat-graft procedures, made in South Korea. Its rounded, blunt tip glides through tissue planes rather than piercing them, allowing controlled product placement over a wide area from a single entry point. It is supplied individually packaged with a matching pre-hole introducer needle.
howItWorks: The blunt, flexible tip pushes vessels and nerves aside instead of cutting through them, reducing the risk of vascular injury, bruising and swelling compared with sharp needles. A single entry point lets the practitioner fan out and treat a broad area, improving patient comfort and placement control.
composition: Blunt-tip micro-cannula with Luer / Luer-lock hub, available in a range of gauges and lengths; sterile and individually wrapped, supplied in boxes of 50 with a matching introducer (pre-hole) needle.
usageNotes: Single-use and sterile; do not reuse or resterilise. Use the supplied pre-hole needle to create the entry point. For trained practitioners with appropriate anatomical knowledge; keep hyaluronidase available whenever HA filler is injected.
features: Blunt, rounded tip for atraumatic tissue navigation
Flexible shaft for broad-area coverage from one entry point
Boxes of 50 with matching pre-hole needle
benefits: Reduces bruising, swelling and vascular-injury risk versus needles
Fewer entry points improves patient comfort
Wide gauge and length range covers multiple indications
Bulk 50-unit box suits regular clinic use
Supports safer filler techniques that can be marketed to patients
indications: Body and large-area filler or biostimulator delivery

description: The JBP Nano Cannula is an ultra-thin-wall, blunt-tip micro-cannula from Japan Bio Products, engineered with Japanese thin-wall technology for filler and mesotherapy injection. Its enlarged internal diameter allows smooth delivery of viscous product through a small outer gauge, while the blunt tip minimises tissue trauma. It is available in a range of gauges and lengths.
howItWorks: As a blunt cannula it separates tissue and displaces vessels rather than cutting them, lowering the risk of bruising, swelling and intravascular injection. The ultra-thin wall widens the internal bore for a given outer gauge, easing the flow of viscous fillers and reducing the force required to inject.
composition: Ultra-thin-wall blunt micro-cannula; gauges spanning approximately 30G to 21G and lengths such as 50-70 mm; commonly supplied 24 pieces per box with matching introducer needles.
usageNotes: Single-use and sterile; do not reuse. Match gauge and length to the treatment area and product viscosity. For trained practitioners; keep hyaluronidase stocked wherever HA filler is used.
features: Ultra-thin wall with enlarged inner diameter
Blunt, flexible tip for atraumatic placement
Smooth delivery of viscous fillers at small gauges
Wide range of gauges and lengths
benefits: Lower injection force eases high-viscosity product delivery
Reduced bruising and downtime supports patient satisfaction
Broad size range fits diverse indications
Recognised manufacturer supports premium positioning
Fewer entry points and improved comfort
indications: Dermal filler injection across face and body

description: Liporase is a lyophilised hyaluronidase enzyme from Korean manufacturer Daehan New Pharm, used to dissolve hyaluronic-acid dermal filler. Each vial is reconstituted with saline and injected to break down unwanted, misplaced or excess HA and, critically, to help manage vascular complications. It is an essential safety-stock item for any clinic offering HA fillers.
howItWorks: Hyaluronidase enzymatically depolymerises hyaluronic acid, rapidly breaking down HA filler so it can be reabsorbed. Because it clears HA that may be compressing or occluding a vessel, prompt injection of hyaluronidase is the first-line treatment for suspected vascular occlusion, in addition to correcting overcorrection, lumps and misplacement.
composition: Hyaluronidase 1500 IU per vial (lyophilised powder); typically 10 vials/ampoules per box. Each vial is reconstituted with approximately 3 mL of sterile saline before use.
usageNotes: Professional use only; reconstitute with sterile saline immediately before injection. Consider patient allergy history and manufacturer guidance (test dosing may be advised). Keep hyaluronidase stocked wherever HA filler is injected so it is immediately available for vascular-occlusion emergencies; store lyophilised vials per label.
features: Targets HA filler for enzymatic breakdown
From Korean manufacturer Daehan New Pharm
benefits: Enables correction of overcorrection, lumps and misplacement
First-line agent for HA-filler vascular-occlusion emergencies
Essential risk-management stock for any HA filler menu
Multi-vial format keeps an emergency supply on hand
Underpins safer marketing of filler services
indications: Dissolution of misplaced or excess HA filler
Correction of nodules, lumps and Tyndall effect
Emergency management of suspected vascular occlusion
Preparation for re-treatment of a previously filled area

description: Derma Shine Pro is a digital, negative-pressure skin-booster injector device from Huons Meditech of South Korea. Using a 9-pin multi-needle head with vacuum-assisted skin fixation and automatic pressure sensing, it standardises micro-droplet delivery of hyaluronic acid, skin boosters and other injectables into the dermis. Huons Meditech received CE (MDR) marking for the device as a digital infusion system.
howItWorks: Negative pressure draws and fixes the skin against the 9-pin multi-needle head; an internal sensor detects the suction and automatically injects a set dose to a preset depth, then releases the vacuum. This automates consistent depth, volume and micro-droplet distribution across the treatment area, reducing operator variability and product loss.
composition: Digital vacuum-assisted injector using a 9-pin multi-screw needle (32G / 34G); adjustable needle depth (approximately 0-1.2 mm), multi-step micro-pressure control and programmable dose (up to roughly 140 shots per session).
usageNotes: Requires trained operation and clinical judgement on product selection and injection depth. Use with genuine single-use 9-pin needle cartridges and do not reuse needle consumables. Follow the manufacturer's cleaning, maintenance and calibration guidance.
features: Automatic pressure sensing with programmable dose and depth
benefits: Standardised, reproducible micro-droplet delivery
Faster, more uniform treatment of large areas
Reduced product loss versus freehand mesotherapy
Improved patient comfort via fine needles and vacuum fixation
Recognised Korean device supports premium menu positioning
indications: Polynucleotide / biostimulator delivery per product indication

description: The Derma Shine Needle is the single-use 9-pin multi-screw needle cartridge consumable for the Derma Shine and Derma Shine Pro injector. Available in fine 32G and 34G gauges, it attaches to the device's vacuum head to deliver skin boosters and mesotherapy solutions at a controlled depth. It is a sterile, single-patient consumable.
howItWorks: The nine fine needles simultaneously penetrate to a device-controlled depth while the injector's vacuum holds the skin in place, so a metered dose is delivered evenly across nine points per actuation. Using multiple fine needles spreads product uniformly and reduces trauma at each point.
composition: 9-pin multi-screw needle cartridge in 32G or 34G; insertion depth is set and adjusted by the host device; sterile, single-use consumable.
usageNotes: Single-use and sterile; discard after each patient and do not resterilise. Use genuine cartridges matched to the Derma Shine device to preserve dosing accuracy and the vacuum seal. Handle and dispose of as a sharps consumable.
features: Designed for the Derma Shine / Pro injector
benefits: Uniform nine-point delivery per actuation
Fine gauges reduce pain and needle marking
Genuine fit maintains dosing accuracy and seal integrity
Recurring consumable supports a device-based service model
Single-use format supports infection control

usageNotes: For professional use with appropriate training. Use with genuine single-use needle consumables and follow the manufacturer's operating, depth-setting and maintenance instructions. Confirm device specifications and regulatory status with the supplier before purchase.
